title: Temple of Literature, Hanoi
axis: Positive Z runs from the main entrance through Khuê Văn pavilion and Thiên Quang Well toward the rear academy. Positive X points northwest across the court.
limits: The five-court exterior follows the PMTiles buildings, pools and paths. Eave profiles, wall heights and individual stele bases are photo-based reconstructions.
The pavilions and approach thresholds fit the standard elevation samples. Water, planting and roads use host data.
Roof ornament and inscription relief are represented at viewing scale. Interior shrines and legible inscriptions are outside this exterior model.
